micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

reason.no_text_model: Set up a text model in Settings to translate.
reason.request_failed: The text model could not be reached.
reason.invalid_output: The text model returned an unusable reply.

overlay.copiedTargetChanged: You switched windows, so the text was copied to the clipboard
overlay.copiedTerminal: Multi-line text was copied instead of pasted into the terminal

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

home.heroHint: Hold your shortcut, speak, and the text lands wherever your cursor is.
home.statEmpty: Start dictating to see your stats here.

dictate.title: Dictate
dictate.description: Press to start and stop voice input.

translate.title: Translate
translate.description: Press to start and stop translation.

activation.title: Activation
activation.description: Tap to start and tap again to finish, or hold while speaking and release to finish.
activation.hold_or_toggle: Tap to toggle + hold to talk

shortcuts.tips: While recording: press Esc or click ✕ to cancel, click ✓ to finish. Holding Fn and then pressing Left Shift switches the current dictation to translation.
shortcuts.fnHardware: Fn only works on Apple keyboards. Choose a different shortcut if you use a third-party keyboard.

fnWarning.title: The Fn key conflicts with a system setting
fnWarning.body: System Settings → Keyboard → “Press 🌐 key to” is set to “{{action}}”. Change it to “Do Nothing”, otherwise Fn also triggers the system action.

history.empty: Nothing here yet. Press your shortcut and start speaking.

usage.shareText: I have dictated {{chars}} characters with Sayso, averaging {{speed}} characters a minute — {{gain}} faster than typing. Current streak: {{streak}} days.

asr.title: Speech recognition
asr.localDesc: Runs offline; audio never leaves this Mac.
asr.cloudDesc: Audio is uploaded to the selected provider.

local.title: Local model
local.importDesc: Choose a SenseVoice folder containing model.int8.onnx and tokens.txt. Nothing is downloaded.
local.empty: No local model is available yet

cloud.title: Cloud recognition
cloud.endpointDesc: Defaults to https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com. For a workspace, use the address shown in the console.
cloud.apiKeyDesc: When empty, the key of the Model Studio text model below is used.
cloud.sendDictionaryDesc: Dictionary terms are sent along with the audio.

text.title: Text model
text.description: Polishes dictation and translates. When enabled, recognized text is sent to the selected service.
text.notConfigured: No text model is set up: dictation inserts the raw transcript and translation is unavailable.

mode.title: Dictation cleanup
mode.offDesc: Insert the transcript as recognized (dictionary replacements still apply).
mode.fixDesc: Fix misheard words, sentence breaks and punctuation only.
mode.polishDesc: Remove fillers and smooth phrasing without changing the meaning.

glm.apiKeyDesc: An API key from the Zhipu BigModel platform (bigmodel.cn).
glm.sendDictionaryDesc: Up to 100 terms. GLM-ASR accepts 30 seconds per request; longer recordings are split automatically.

stepfun.endpointDesc: Defaults to https://api.stepfun.com/v1. Step Plan subscription keys cannot use this endpoint.
stepfun.apiKeyDesc: An API key from the StepFun platform (platform.stepfun.com, under Interface keys).
stepfun.sendDictionaryDesc: Up to 100 terms. Chinese and English only; long recordings are split into 3-minute chunks and recognized in parallel.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.description: Names and terms, plus how they tend to be misheard. Misheard forms are replaced literally and the terms are passed to the text model; translation uses the fixed translations.
dictionary.empty: No entries yet. Add product names, people or jargon you say often.
dictionary.importPlaceholder:
One entry per line:
term | misheard 1, misheard 2 | translation | note
or: misheard → term

general.title: General
general.autostartDesc: Run Sayso in the menu bar after you log in.
general.targetLanguageDesc: You can also switch it on the overlay while recording.
general.microphoneDesc: Input device used for voice input.
general.clipboardDesc: After inserting text, also leave the result on the clipboard.
general.basedOn: Based on the open-source Handy project (MIT).

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Sayso needs these permissions to type into any app.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.windowsDesc: Sayso records through the system microphone. If it is blocked, enable it in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, including "Let desktop apps access your microphone".

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Paste text into the focused field.

inputMonitoring.title: Input Monitoring
inputMonitoring.description: Detect global shortcuts such as Fn.

permissions.restartHint: If shortcuts still do nothing after granting, quit and reopen Sayso.

onboarding.subtitle: Press Fn, speak, and clean text appears at your cursor.
onboarding.downloadDesc: About {{size}} MB. Offline recognition for 30 languages including Chinese and English, with automatic language detection.
onboarding.importDesc: If you already have the sherpa-onnx SenseVoice int8 model, use it instead of downloading.
onboarding.cloudDesc: StepFun, Alibaba Cloud or Zhipu GLM; audio is uploaded. Add the API key later under Models.
